# 360 Media Group

> 360 Media Group is a Sunshine Coast, Queensland media company run by Jack Borthwick. We make media easy for two things: entertainment (360 photo booth, DJ, photography, videography and event packages for weddings, parties and corporate events) and business (websites, social media and marketing for local businesses). One crew, one invoice.

- Based on the Sunshine Coast, QLD. Services Noosa, Maroochydore, Mooloolaba, Caloundra, Buderim, Nambour, Brisbane and the Gold Coast.
- Phone: 0461 406 627 · Email: hire360photobooth@gmail.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/360.media.group/
- Google reviews: https://g.page/r/CRX7OYHWCkoSEBM
- Prices on each service page are the current ones. 3-hour minimum on hourly services. Editing always included.

## Entertainment services

- [360 Photo Booth Hire Sunshine Coast](https://360mediagroupaustralia.com.au/360-photo-booth-hire-sunshine-coast): 360 booth with operator and props for weddings, formals, 18ths and corporate events. From $185/hr.
- [Wedding DJ Sunshine Coast](https://360mediagroupaustralia.com.au/wedding-dj-sunshine-coast): DJ with pro sound and lighting, MC, ceremony sound and Dancing on a Cloud. From $300/hr.
- [Event Photographer & Videographer Sunshine Coast](https://360mediagroupaustralia.com.au/event-photography-videography-sunshine-coast): Wedding and event photo and video, editing included, next-day highlights available. From $300/hr.
- [Wedding Entertainment Packages Sunshine Coast](https://360mediagroupaustralia.com.au/wedding-entertainment-packages-sunshine-coast): DJ, 360 booth, photography and video from one crew on one invoice. From $2,300.
- [School Formal Photo Booth & DJ](https://360mediagroupaustralia.com.au/school-formal-photo-booth-dj-sunshine-coast): 360 booth and DJ for school formals.
- [18th & 21st Party Entertainment](https://360mediagroupaustralia.com.au/18th-21st-birthday-party-entertainment-sunshine-coast): DJ, lighting and 360 booth, 4 hours for $2,300.
- [Corporate Event Entertainment](https://360mediagroupaustralia.com.au/corporate-event-entertainment-sunshine-coast): Branded booths, DJ, photography and next-day social reels for launches and Christmas parties.
- [Boat Party Package Brisbane](https://360mediagroupaustralia.com.au/boat-party-package-brisbane): Private boat party on the Baroness, Brisbane River, up to 80 guests, 5 hours, $11,990.
